description:
You are a sustainability specialist at an energy consulting firm. The 4StoreyBuilding commercial facility has been identified for an Energy Conservation Measure (ECM) package targeting two synergistic strategies: (1) cool-surface compliance to reduce solar heat gain, and (2) improved free-cooling utilization via tighter economizer control. Your client requires all measures to be implemented in a single project save, followed by an annual simulation to quantify energy savings.

Your scope of work:
- Reduce the solar absorptance of the exterior wall construction ('EWall Construction') from the current value to 0.45 to comply with ENERGY STAR cool-wall criteria.
- Reduce the solar absorptance of the roof construction ('Roof Construction') from the current value to 0.45, implementing a high-reflectance cool roof.
- For all five Ground Floor (G.*) packaged single-zone HVAC systems, lower the dry-bulb economizer temperature limit (DRYBULB-LIMIT) from the current value to 65°F to enable more aggressive free cooling.
- Run the full annual DOE-2.2 simulation to compute the predicted energy savings from these combined measures.
- Save the project.

No step-by-step UI instructions are provided. You must navigate the eQUEST interface to locate the Building Shell, Construction, and Air-Side HVAC sections independently.
